name: options-mode
title: An options mode for the architect plugin
outcome: An engineer runs /architect:options and gets one self-contained HTML report of inquiries about the flow, the technology, and the gaps of the whole system, with alternatives and diagrams. The engineer pastes the decisions text into /architect:design.
done_when: /architect:options dispatches the architecture skill, and the skill declares seven modes
a validator script passes a good report and fails each broken fixture for the intended reason
the full test suite passes with the mode count at seven, and the mode ships no agent, hook, or MCP server
abort_if: a read of design stage 3 shows that options adds no inquiry that stage 3 would not find

min_work.derived_from: 4 districts (skills, scripts, commands, docs), 3 colliding ADRs (ADR-0013, ADR-0017, ADR-0018), 1 boundary rule on install surface (ADR-0025)
min_work.note: Stage 3 (divergent exploration) was skipped on the engineer's word: no need, the main options were settled in chat. Stage 4 ran with two cited challenges, ADR-0013 (contested, the engineer kept the separate mode) and ADR-0018 (accepted for now).

epics.note: One epic. Four slices: the mode and its command, the report template and validator, the manifests and glossary and counts, and one real run of the mode.
